format: glTF 2.0 binary; self-contained; no geometry decoder required

hair.source: original short curls over anatomical scalp

Muscle.applyTo: Every mesh that exposes the target

Build.applyTo: Every mesh that exposes the target

Face_1..Face_5.applyTo: Every mesh that exposes the target

morphs.normals: Position morph targets retained; base vertex normals and skinning retained

materials.Skin: Opaque photographic CC0 fair-skin albedo plus original pore normal. Runtime tint multiplies albedo; use white (#ffffff) as the original fair reference, or tint toward desired skin colour. Do not replace the photo map.
materials.Hair_0..Hair_5: Set material.color from chosen hair colour; retain alpha maps on styles 0,1,2,3,5. Hair_4 is original opaque curl geometry.
materials.KitTrim: Set from selected kit trim colour.
materials.BootLaces: May set from equipment accent colour.
materials.Eyes: Preserve texture alpha for transparent cornea shell; forcing opaque causes black eyes.

kitUV.layout: Front U .04..46, Back U .54..96; Blender V=0 hem, V=1 neckline. GLB UV coordinates are V flipped. Canvas top therefore maps to neckline with texture.flipY=false.
kitUV.kitNumber: Draw in generated canvas texture; no player identity baked into mesh.

desktopVsMobile: Identical mesh, skin, morph and animation contract. Phone maps are 512px hair/eyes/teeth and 1024px skin; desktop uses 1024px hair and up to 2048px core skin.
license: CC0-1.0 assets; see LICENSES.json and source licence notices
qualityChecks: GLB JSON and buffer data inspected for skinning, normalized nonzero weights, morph deltas and all four clips.
Headless Cycles renders inspected: full body, face, side, body extremes, all six face presets, all six hairstyles, equipment and movement poses.
The final shipped GLB was re-imported into a clean Blender scene and rendered at idle, strong build/muscle and raised-arm celebration.
